From: Ellie Tran <ellie@retailco.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick tech triage before Redwood demo?

Hey Karthik,

I signed up for a self-serve account yesterday and my team is excited to see Redwood in action. Before we do a full demo, our infra lead wants a short 15-minute technical triage to confirm compatibility with our existing stack (mainly caching, KV layers, and our VPC egress constraints).

Are you available for a quick call this week? We’re West Coast (PST). I can do: 
- Tue 11/17 between 10:00–11:30am PST
- Wed 11/18 between 2:00–4:00pm PST

If possible, can you include one of your Solutions Engineers to confirm network/KMS questions? I attached a tiny stack summary that shows our core components.

Thanks — appreciate the speedy help.

Ellie Tran
Head of Engineering, RetailCo
ellie@retailco.com
(415) 555-0119

Attachments: retailco-stack-summary.csv (summary of services, port requirements, and expected QPS)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Tran <ellie@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick tech triage before Redwood demo?

Hi Ellie — thanks for signing up and for the stack summary, that helps a lot. I’m on the SDR side but I’ll bring Marissa (Solutions Eng) to the 15-min triage so she can answer the KMS/VPC questions.

I’m available for the two windows you proposed; can we lock Tue 11/17 at 10:30am PST? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite (15 minutes) and post a short intake form for a couple of live details (eg. IP allowlist, model sizes you expect to use).

If 10:30 doesn’t work, Marissa is also free Wed 11/18 at 2:30pm PST.

Quick note: please upload any network diagram you have — that makes the triage faster.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
